name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled multi-site virtual hosts, including static hosting, certificates, security headers, rate limiting, fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and kernel network hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication and runtime directories, and applies the required Redis configuration workaround.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with a virtual environment and dependencies, provisions its database and environment configuration, and runs it as a systemd service on port 8000.
